what_i_did: Read lab/TASKS.md, tasks/coding/spec.md, tasks/coding/dev.json and the code_tests checker in lab/core.py.

Authored 21 write-from-spec tasks over dicts, nested lists, tuples and record lists (count, transpose, one-level flatten, ordered dedupe, index by key, merge with zero-drop, distinct multi-key sort, rotate, dict diff, inner join, grouped totals with tie-break, stack and bounded-queue simulations, nest tuple keys, left join, league table, latest-per-id dedupe, pivot with fill, deep merge without mutation, mixed-direction 3-level sort, multiset difference).

Built the file with a script (kept outside the repo, in the session scratchpad) that executes each reference solution and writes every assert's expected value from the reference's actual output; no expected value was hand-computed.
The first assert of every task is the example call stated in the prompt (asserted by the build script).
Tests only cover behaviour stated in the prompt; where the prompt asks for lists of lists or tuples the asserts normalise the inner container type so list/tuple surface form does not matter.
verification: lab/validate_tasks.py ran each reference (must pass) and each negative (must fail) in the sandbox.
notes: Difficulty split 5 easy / 8 medium / 8 hard, skewed harder per spec.md difficulty guidance (baseline was above target). Difficulty labels are estimates; no pilot was run because the tasks are held-out.
